summary: For the volume the fibre is a box; its mass is a product of volumes of the B^Γ_{j+4}.

steps.claim: K: the product set B^Γ_{j+4} × vecsOfSize(j+4) × vecsOfSize(j+4) × B^Γ_{j+4} is measurable.

steps.lean:
⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, inferInstance, measurePreserving_pair_sumElim.comp
    (measurePreserving_swap.comp measurePreserving_shuffle_coords), map_floorBasis_volume ..,
    by tauto, measurable_measure_prodMk_left K, fun p w ↦ measure_mono fun _ ↦
steps.claim: The witnesses: ζ = volume on the remaining coordinates, k = a regrouping of coordinates (measure preserving), whose image under E^F_b is floorVolume(b) (map_floorBasis_volume); μ(p) = the ζ-mass of the box fibre, measurable; and the fibre is contained in that box (measure_mono).

steps.lean:
by simp; tauto, by
    simp [↓← Measure.prod_apply K, volume, ← mem_univ_pi, -Set.mem_pi]
    grw [volume_le, card_finset_fin_le, Γ.two_le_and_pairs_le.2] <;> ring_nf <;> bound⟩
steps.claim: ∫ μ ≤ vol(B^Γ_{j+4})^{(number of coordinates)} ≤ Λ_Γ^{(j+5)·…} ≤ Λ_Γ^{99(ϱ+1)(j+6)} (vol(B^Γ_i) ≤ Λ_Γ^{i+1}, the number of pairs at most m + ϱ with m ≤ 9(ϱ+1)).
